name: FFmpeg
description: Decoding, conversion and analysis. FFmpeg 8.1 (libavcodec 62.28), built with --enable-version3 and without --enable-gpl or --enable-nonfree, so it is used under the LGPL v3 or later. Published as com.antonkarpenko:ffmpeg-kit-full 2.2.1, built with the build scripts of github.com/sk3llo/ffmpeg-kit, which download FFmpeg and its libraries at build time. FFmpeg source: ffmpeg.org, release 8.1.
